**Limitations**

- Assumes most pixels are background. A dark object larger than the window turns white in its middle, as Bradley and Roth note.
- In very dark areas the percent rule leaves only a small margin, so noise can turn black.

**Artifacts**

- Hollow dark objects when the window is too small.
- Speckle in dark, noisy areas.
